d.d: The outer skin of a citrus fruit, used as a flavouring or garnish.
d.x: The orange zest gives the strong flavor in this dish.
I add zest to the meat by rubbing it with a spice mixture before grilling.

d.d: Enthusiasm; keen enjoyment; exciting and interesting; relish or gusto; a state of being zesty.
d.x: Auntie Mame had a real zest for life.

d.d: To scrape the zest from a fruit.
Having a piquant or pungent taste; spicy.
(of a man) Flamboyantly or effeminately gay.
